sayLines.text: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Daniela speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Daniela speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⛓️ Ashford doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.

With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Owen speaks at The Bloodied's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Ashford's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Ashford installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. The Hungry Road's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) The Hungry Road installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Emberhold, Thornfield, The Bloodied count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."

◈ SYSTEM: "33. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,034 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The climb is not over.
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 2,240 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
With Haven grieving, The Hungry Road installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

With Haven grieving again, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National and global no longer describe this village. The climb starts over.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🖱️ The Algorithm trailers its next move at Diana — the predictable get countered.
